configuration: ADR-0014, 30 mm cylinder, 81-trial production-primitive tolerance campaign
finding: The primary measured blocker is contact-descend terminal feasibility, not perception: 69/81 trials failed IK before close. Of the five descents that executed, observed contact was table interference or one-finger contact with a non-target cylinder; no bilateral target contact formed.

isolated_lateral_diagnostics.mode: target collision retained throughout lateral insertion
isolated_lateral_diagnostics.observed: A 60 degree candidate at 65 mm executed and converged at high-clear and low-clear. Its final lateral pose had an IK solution but failed MoveIt planning (5 attempts); no close or contact occurred.

isolated_lateral_diagnostics.mode: 65 mm lateral insertion with target-touch exception limited to final insert
isolated_lateral_diagnostics.observed: The yaw-0 high-clear and low-clear stages executed and converged. The final lateral stage failed IK (-31), produced no contact, and the temporary target-touch exception was restored.

diagnostic_conclusion: Neither retaining target collision nor allowing only the final target touch produced an executable terminal insertion. These diagnostics are calibration-only and do not alter the production primitive or acceptance state.
inference_boundary: The report does not identify a final corrective geometry or planner change. It establishes that any corrective action must first make a collision-safe terminal descend physically feasible and avoid table/non-target contact, then remeasure the full envelope.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not relax bilateral, attach, reset, or perception gate thresholds.
Do not use supervision as an online motion or contact input.
Do not run round-trip or WRONG_OBJECT acceptance while the reachability gate is NO_GO.
